AGENDA
  CDBG ADVISORY COMMITTEE SPECIAL MEETING
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  613 E. Broadway, 2nd Floor
  Glendale, CA 91206
Meetings are broadcast live on Glendale TV, viewable on Spectrum Cable, channel 6, and AT&T U-
verse, channel 99. Meetings are also streamed live in high definition (HD) on the city's webpage,
glendaleca.gov/live, on YouTube.com/myglendale, and on Apple TV, Roku, and Amazon Fire
devices using a free app called Screenweave and choosing “Glendale TV” from the menu. Meetings
are also archived on the City Website for viewing anytime at glendaleca.gov/agendas. Call (818)
548-4013 for program schedules. DVDs of the proceedings are available for purchase in the
Community Services & Parks Administration Office, 613 E. Broadway, Room 120, Glendale, CA
91206. For public comments and questions during the meeting, call (818) 937-8100. Public
comments on a specific agenda item will be taken when that agenda item is discussed. If you have
any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for assistance, please contact the
Community Services & Parks Administration Office at (818) 548-2782 during regular business
hours.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE MEETING LOCATION
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
are available same-day upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required for
requests regarding sign language translation and Braille transcription services. All documents
related to open session items on this agenda that are received less than 72 hours prior to this
meeting, and are public records, will be available for review in the Community Services & Parks
Administration Office, 613 E. Broadway, RM 120, Glendale, CA 91206.
Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who
wish to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City
Clerk’s office at (818) 548-2090, at least 24 hours prior to the scheduled meeting. Please specify
the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City provided interpreters is not
required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak in their native language.
  MARCH 6, 2023 AT 8:00 AM

  A SPECIAL MEETING of the CDBG Advisory Committee is hereby called to meet at 8:00 AM
on March 6, 2023, in the City Council Chambers to consider the following item of business, to wit:

1.  ROLL CALL
  a.  Report of Recording Secretary re: Posting of Agenda. The Agenda for the March 6,
  2023 special meeting of the CDBG Advisory Committee was posted on or before
   Friday, March 3, 2023, on the Bulletin Board outside City Hall.

2.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to items not a part of this agenda. Each speaker is allowed five (5)
  minutes. The Commission may question the speaker, but there will be no debate or decision.
  Staff may refer the matter to the proper section or department for investigation and report.

3.  REPORTS-INFORMATION ONLY
  a.  Status of Active Community Capital Improvement Projects
  b.  Update on Reprogramming of City CDBG CIP Funds (Oral Report)

4.  ACTION ITEMS
  a.  Reprogramming returned FY 2022-2023 Hamilton House CDBG Community Capital
  Improvement Project funds from The Campbell Center
  1. Motion providing direction to staff on reprogramming $377,883.50 in returned FY
  2022-2023 CDBG Community Capital Improvement Project (CIP) funds from The
  Campbell Center, Hamilton House CIP Project.
  b.  Funding Recommendations for FY 2023-2024 Capital Improvement Projects
  1. Conduct interviews with capital improvement applicants; deliberate and make funding
  recommendations.

5.  COMMITTEE/STAFF COMMENTS

6.  ADJOURNMENT
